name: deep16
description: Deep16 - 16-bit RISC ISA with assembler, disassembler, JS/WASM/RTL simulators and a browser IDE

scripts.lint:rtl: verilator --lint-only -Wall --top-module deep16_top rtl/deep16_pkg.sv rtl/deep16_alu.sv rtl/deep16_regfile.sv rtl/deep16_cache.sv rtl/deep16_divider.sv rtl/deep16_uart.sv rtl/deep16_core.sv rtl/deep16_top.sv
scripts.lint:mini: verilator --lint-only -Wall -DD16MINI --top-module deep16_top rtl/deep16_pkg.sv rtl/deep16_alu.sv rtl/deep16_regfile.sv rtl/deep16_cache.sv rtl/deep16_divider.sv rtl/deep16_uart.sv rtl/deep16_core.sv rtl/deep16_top.sv
scripts.lint:board: verilator --lint-only -Wall -DD16MINI --top-module deep16_board rtl/deep16_pkg.sv rtl/deep16_alu.sv rtl/deep16_regfile.sv rtl/deep16_cache.sv rtl/deep16_divider.sv rtl/deep16_uart.sv rtl/ps2_rx.sv rtl/deep16_timer.sv rtl/deep16_spi.sv rtl/deep16_core.sv rtl/deep16_top.sv rtl/deep16_board.sv
